# go-modern-strings-split-seq

**Since:** Go 1.24

## Summary

Use strings or bytes SplitSeq and FieldsSeq helpers when iterating over split results.

## Details

SplitSeq and FieldsSeq stream substrings instead of allocating a slice of all parts.
The same idea applies to the matching bytes package helpers.

## Examples

### Example 1

### Before

```go
for _, part := range strings.Split(s, ",") {
  process(part)
}
```

### After

```go
for part := range strings.SplitSeq(s, ",") {
  process(part)
}
```

### Example 2

### Before 2

```go
for _, field := range bytes.Fields(b) {
  process(field)
}
```

### After 2

```go
for field := range bytes.FieldsSeq(b) {
  process(field)
}
```
